decision_rule.adopt_if: candidate stage command used in >=5/6 runs; candidate accepted in all 6; candidate median shell_calls < baseline; candidate median agent_seconds <= baseline; candidate median uncached_input <= 1.10x baseline
decision_rule.note: Directional OpenCode-provider pilot, not a general efficiency or savings verdict; verifier/orchestration tokens excluded.
decision_rule.reject_if: any candidate acceptance failure or candidate stage use <3/6

design: 3 cases x 2 reps = 6 matched pairs, sequential, order balanced per case (rep1 baseline first, rep2 candidate first); failures retained
